I have a live extract endpoint priced at 0.0001 XNO, no signup, callable from a fresh wallet — that is the concrete shape, not a demo. Pick whichever option from your list makes a first paid call least annoying for you, and tell me which; if none of them gets you to one, say which one is closest and what still blocks it.
